title: UPI collect requests timing out
alert: HikariPool-1 connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. p99 latency 11.3s
root cause: maxPoolSize was 20 and idle-in-transaction sessions held connections open during the salary-day peak
failed fixes: Restarting payments-api pods (timeouts returned within minutes)
fix: Moved the finance report to the read replica and killed the long-running sessions

title: Money debited but payment shown failed
alert: 140 complaints: amount debited, status FAILED, no auto-reversal after 30 minutes. Example VPA arun.p@okicici
root cause: A deploy renamed the reversal queue so reversal-worker consumed from an empty queue
fix: Pointed reversal-worker at the correct queue and re-ran the missed reversal batch for the last 6 hours

title: UPI collect requests timing out
alert: payments-api p99 11.3s during the IPL final evening, Hikari waiting threads above 150
root cause: maxPoolSize was 20 and idle-in-transaction sessions held connections open during the IPL final evening
fix: Killed idle-in-transaction sessions and raised maxPoolSize from 20 to 60

title: Settlement file upload failed
alert: SFTP authentication failed uploading the settlement file to Kotak; merchant payouts delayed
root cause: Kotak rotated its SFTP host key and our client rejected the new fingerprint
failed fixes: Retrying the upload repeatedly (locked the SFTP account)
fix: Bank ops unlocked the account, we added the new host fingerprint and re-uploaded the file

title: OTP delivery dropped
alert: otp-service delivery_rate=41%, sms-gateway-a responding 429 Too Many Requests
root cause: A marketing push during the IPL final evening used the same SMS route as OTPs and gateway A throttled us
failed fixes: Bulk-retrying failed OTPs (made the throttling worse)
fix: Failed over OTP traffic to sms-gateway-b and resumed the campaign in batches

title: UPI callbacks delayed from partner bank
alert: upi-switch callback latency p99 7.9s for Axis, pending transactions growing
root cause: Axis was degraded on the payment switch and our retries doubled the load on it
fix: Enabled the bank-level circuit breaker for Axis and showed a "bank is slow" banner in the app
